name: Barn N Bunk
tagline: WELCOME TO THE BERRY BARN – Mt. Liberty, Ohio
description: Barn N Bunk is an agritourism farm in 3677 Wayne-Madison Road, OH, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
